two_axis_falsifier.finding: A projection that collapses observation/system time into the latest validity state cannot reproduce historical truth-as-known-then for retroactively corrected evidence.

negative_evidence.defect: The first ambiguity fixture cloned a row from the wrong relation, so it failed to create two simultaneously active versions for the queried relation and did not exercise the fail-closed ambiguity gate.
negative_evidence.repair: The rerun selects the canonical rel-00001 row explicitly, clones that same relation with a conflicting version_id, and requires query output AMBIGUOUS.

supported: Graphiti-style validity windows are useful only when kept distinct from observation/system time for historical reconstruction.
A thin derived projection can preserve exact source lineage, deterministic rebuild and fail-closed ambiguity without becoming canonical truth.
The structural mechanism is sufficiently supported to justify an E5 thin-native build-candidate design for F2, subject to a separate atomic claim.
not_supported: No recommendation to import full Graphiti, Neo4j, FalkorDB or another canonical graph store.
No Graphiti runtime, LLM extraction, target VPS/runtime, UnifiedDB integration, GWT, causal reasoning or whole-system claim.
No production latency or storage-efficiency claim from the simple scan baseline or JSON size proxy.

limitations: The baseline scan is deliberately simple and is not current UnifiedDB query performance.
Latency is a local-container microbenchmark only.
JSON byte count is a structural proxy, not SQLite page, RSS or PSS cost.
The projection was not bound to the actual future Phase-3/4 workload or current UnifiedDB schema.
next_exact_action: If no E5 claim already exists, atomically claim and write a thin F2-native bitemporal build-candidate contract with explicit system-time plus valid-time query coordinates, exact canonical source refs/digests/generation, deterministic rebuild/deletion semantics, fail-closed overlap, and Trigger-4 acceptance against actual Phase-3/4 workload before any integration credit.
